en_title: Valve Says It's Seen a 'Significant Increase' in Steam Game Submissions in Recent Months, Amid 'AI Slop' Claims
cn_title: 在「AI垃圾」争议中，Valve称近几个月Steam游戏提交量「大幅增加」
opus_summary: Valve表示，近几个月Steam商店页面和游戏版本的送审数量显著增加，平均审核时间已从通常的3至5个工作日延长至12个工作日。Valve正改进审核流程，并曾表示无计划在Steam全面禁止AI游戏。

paragraphs.en: Valve’s approval process has always taken a bit of time, but it’s taking much longer lately because of the staggering volume of games hoping to launch on the platform — an issue that’s only grown with the advent of generative AI.
paragraphs.cn: Valve的审批流程一直需要花费一些时间，但最近耗时长了许多，因为希望在该平台上推出的游戏数量惊人——随着生成式AI的出现，这个问题愈发严重。

paragraphs.en: As of November 2026, approximately 24,299 games have been released on Steam this year alone, compared to 10 years ago when around 4,500 games launched across the entire year of 2016.
paragraphs.cn: 截至2026年11月，仅今年一年就已有约24,299款游戏在Steam上发售；相比之下，10年前的2016年全年约有4,500款游戏发售。

paragraphs.en: Unless you’re a major publisher with a proven track record, all games must undergo Valve’s testing process to make sure they’re fit for Steam and don’t riddle players’ computers with malware. But many games are now missing their release dates because of this backlog.
paragraphs.cn: 除非你是一家有可靠过往业绩的大型发行商，否则所有游戏都必须经过Valve的测试流程，以确保它们适合在Steam上推出，且不会让玩家的电脑感染大量恶意软件。但由于积压，许多游戏如今错过了发售日期。

paragraphs.en: The issue has gotten so bad that Valve put out an official statement acknowledging the issue. “We've seen a significant increase in submissions for store page and build review in recent months, and have spent the last several weeks working to scale our process to match it,” Valve said.
paragraphs.cn: 这个问题已经严重到Valve发布了一份官方声明予以承认。Valve表示：「近几个月来，我们看到提交商店页面和游戏构建版本审核的数量大幅增加，过去几周我们一直在努力扩大审核流程的规模，以适应这一情况。」

paragraphs.en: “Though we still have a ways to go, we want to share the initial improvements that have shipped in the past weeks. The changes are designed to help more developers pass build review the first time, and cut down on re-reviews for basic functional issues.”
paragraphs.cn: 「尽管我们还有很长的路要走，但我们希望分享过去几周已经推出的初步改进。这些改动旨在帮助更多开发者首次提交时就通过构建版本审核，并减少因基本功能问题而进行的重复审核。」

paragraphs.en: Usually it takes Valve 3-5 business days to review a game, but the average is now 12 business days. Some of the delay is due to developers not being ready, games being rejected or having to be retested. Valve left a series of tips for developers to pass approvals the first time.
paragraphs.cn: Valve审核一款游戏通常需要3至5个工作日，但现在平均需要12个工作日。部分延误是由于开发者尚未准备就绪、游戏被拒或必须重新测试。Valve为开发者提供了一系列建议，帮助他们首次提交时就通过审核。

paragraphs.en: "We've heard from a lot of developers and know how stressful it's been having to wait for review build updates longer than expected," Valve said. "More improvements are coming to the build review process, but these initial changes are a great starting point."
paragraphs.cn: Valve表示：「我们听取了许多开发者的意见，知道等待构建版本审核进度更新的时间超出预期，给大家带来了多大压力。构建版本审核流程还会迎来更多改进，但这些初步改动是一个很好的起点。」

paragraphs.en: Valve didn’t address the AI issue in the post, but the issue has grown to the point where Valve employees are being asked how Steam plans to address the issue. Valve’s Steam Business Team took to the stage at the recent Steam Indie Connect event in Korea and took questions from an audience of game developers. During the chat, the issue of Steam being flooded with AI slop and knockoff AI clones came up, and Valve said it was still trying to figure out how to navigate this new world.
paragraphs.cn: Valve没有在帖子中提及AI问题，但这一问题已经严重到Valve员工被问及Steam计划如何应对的地步。在最近于韩国举行的Steam Indie Connect活动上，Valve的Steam商务团队登台回答了现场游戏开发者的提问。交流期间，有人提到了Steam上充斥着AI垃圾内容和山寨AI克隆游戏的问题，Valve表示仍在努力弄清楚如何应对这个新世界。

paragraphs.en: At the time, Valve said there are no plans to outright ban AI games from Steam, and suggested developers do more to stand out so their games can’t be easily cloned.
paragraphs.cn: 当时，Valve表示没有计划在Steam上彻底禁止AI游戏，并建议开发者做更多努力来脱颖而出，让自己的游戏不容易被克隆。

paragraphs.en: Steam currently requires developers to disclose AI usage, giving customers the option to vote with their wallets. Epic Games boss Tim Sweeney doesn’t like this at all, calling it a “political message.” Indie storefront Itch recently deleted what it called “terabytes of AI slop” from its store, which made it difficult for users to find the things they were looking for.
paragraphs.cn: Steam目前要求开发者披露AI的使用情况，让消费者可以选择用钱包投票。Epic Games负责人Tim Sweeney对此非常不满，称其为一种「政治信息」。独立游戏商店Itch最近从商店中删除了它所说的「数TB的AI垃圾内容」，这些内容让用户很难找到自己想要的东西。
